source_contract.domain_selection: select the 10 frozen Domain VI source nodes in exact source order

batching.rule: No frozen source node may be omitted, duplicated, renamed, reordered, or migrated.

candidate_requirements.subskills: Each requirement receives a bounded assessable capability statement and matching provisional decomposition edge.
candidate_requirements.prerequisite_edges: Do not infer hard dependencies from source order. Preserve uncertain relationships as UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL.
candidate_requirements.acyclicity: Every cumulative candidate must remain acyclic and endpoint-resolvable under Validator 003.

successor_instruction: Materialize exact frozen Domain VI nodes VI.A.1, VI.A.2, VI.A.3, VI.B.1 and VI.B.2; add only evidence-bound provisional subskills/decomposition; preserve uncertain dependencies explicitly; validate cumulatively against completed Domains I-V; then continue final Batch 02.
stop_condition: All 10 frozen Domain VI requirements have truthful exact-source-order structural dispositions across two hosted-validated batches; cumulative Validator 003 covers all 66 frozen requirements; uncertainty and human/SME/certification boundaries remain explicit; then execute full-graph closure and next-successor selection rather than declaring learner effectiveness or production readiness.
